meta.title: Game Bench
meta.description: A Famicom-style console inside DeepSeek: built-in games that ship with the plugin and work offline (the public build includes an original pixel demo; owners can configure their own classics), plus a game market to search and download 1000+ more NES games. The player includes a CRT filter, gamepad and touch controls, three save slots plus auto-save every minute, speed control, screenshots and fullscreen.
